steps.title: Define App Metadata
steps.description: Configure the unique package name com.welcomeapp.app and internal metadata for Welcome App.

steps.title: Configure Build Settings
steps.description: Setup project-level build script compatibility targeting Android SDK 34 and Gradle 8.5.

steps.title: Declare App Manifest
steps.description: Register MainActivity as launcher activity with launcher categories inside AndroidManifest.xml.

steps.title: Design Welcome Layout
steps.description: Construct UI displaying the 'hello Welcome' greeting using Android system RelativeLayout and TextView controls.

steps.title: Implement Main Activity
steps.description: Develop Java class loading the UI layout to display the greeting on application launch.

steps.title: Validate Manifest Namespace
steps.description: Confirm XML namespaces align with standard Android SDK requirements.

steps.title: Verify Target SDK Compatibility
steps.description: Validate targetSdkVersion and compileSdkVersion values against required SDK build tools.

steps.title: Confirm Java 8 Compliance
steps.description: Review MainActivity source code to ensure strict compatibility with Java 8 runtimes.

steps.title: Validate Icon Resources
steps.description: Ensure launcher icon configurations correctly reference standard drawable icon resource paths.

steps.title: Building Welcome App
steps.description: Launch the automated build pipeline to compile resources, package sources, and output the debug APK.
